headline: MapQuest adds a layer showing Flock surveillance camera locations
summary: MapQuest's app now displays the locations of Flock and other automated license-plate-reader cameras, letting users see nearby surveillance points. Outlets describe the feature as helping people identify or avoid these cameras while driving.

claims.statement: MapQuest added a feature showing the locations of Flock and other ALPR surveillance cameras.

sources.quote: MapQuest will now show you where Flock cameras are in your neighborhood
Flock camera locations revealed on MapQuest’s new Surveillance Layer
How to find Flock cameras near you with MapQuest’s new ‘surveillance layer’

claims.statement: The feature can help users avoid or stay out of sight of these cameras.

sources.quote: This new feature could help users avoid Flock and other ALPR cameras.
to help you stay out of sight of surveillance cameras
